gloss: to be liked; to be popular

definitions.gloss: to be liked; to be loved; to be popular
definitions.explanation: The passive form of {好|す}く, used to express that someone or something is liked or well-received by others. Much more common than the active form {好|す}く in modern Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好|す}かれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好|す}かれる⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be the kind of student that teachers like.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好|す}かれる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To be liked by others, it is important to first listen carefully to what they have to say.

notes:
The passive form of {好|す}く (to like), but far more commonly used than the active form in modern Japanese. While ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (the adjective) is the standard way to express liking something, {好|す}かれる is the natural way to say someone is liked by others. The active verb {好|す}く is relatively rare in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好|す}かれる: to be liked by everyone
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{好|す}かれる: to be liked by people
- {好|す}かれる⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a likable personality
- {好|す}かれる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a popular/well-liked person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愛|あい}される→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧: to be loved — deeper emotional attachment than being liked
- モテる: to be popular (romantically) — specifically about romantic attractiveness
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be popular — broader, can apply to things, places, celebrities
